newsitem.title: USA: Aura to spin off NewCom unit via IPO.
newsitem.headline: Aura to spin off NewCom unit via IPO.

text.p: Aura Systems Inc, a maker of high-technology electronics products, on Thursday said it planned to spin off its NewCom division in an initial public offering of stock.
NewCom has registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell units consisting of one share of common stock and one common stock purchase warrant, Aura said in a statement.
A spokesman said the final number of offered units has yet to be determined, but Aura planned to retain about 80 percent of the company and sell the remaining portion in the IPO.
The units will be sold by an underwriting group managed by Joseph Charles & Associates Inc, based in Beverly Hills, California.
NewCom provides communications products for standard facsimile and data modems. NewCom also sells a product called WebPal, which provides Internet access to television users.
